newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU formally warns Volkswagen over Italian market.
newsitem.headline: EU formally warns Volkswagen over Italian market.

text.p: The European Commission said on Thursday it had sent Volkswagen and its subsidiary Audi statements of objections warning them about distribution restrictions in the Italian market.

The statement, which follows inspections carried out one year ago at the companies' premises in Germany and at their common Italian distributor called Autogerma, gives the companies until mid-January to reply.
At stake are practices developed by the German carmakers in Italy aiming at preventing Austrian as well as German and French consumers from buying their cars at the cheaper Italian rate in Italy.

The Commission had already warned Volkswagen about such practices -- which violate the principle of free movement of goods -- earlier this year and announced that it would send a formal statement to the companies this autumn. - BRUSSELS NEWSROOM: +32 2 287-6830
